Steps: Open the Speak Back card from the Home screen.
Expected Result: The Speak Back flow opens at the Choose a Friend screen.
Actual Result: The Speak Back flow opened at the Choose a Friend screen.

Steps: Choose an eligible friend from the friend list.
Expected Result: The selected eligible friend is carried into the next screen.
Actual Result: The selected friend was carried into the next screen successfully.

Steps: Review the speaking prompt, helpful phrases and example answer.
Expected Result: A level-appropriate prompt with three helpful phrases is displayed, and the optional example answer can be viewed.
Actual Result: The speaking prompt and helpful phrases were displayed, and the example answer could be viewed.

Steps: Select Shuffle prompt, then select I'm ready.
Expected Result: A new prompt at a comparable level appears and the user can continue to the recording screen.
Actual Result: A new prompt appeared after selecting Shuffle prompt, and the flow continued to the recording screen.

Steps: Record a voice reply and listen to the preview.
Expected Result: The user can record a reply and listen to the preview before sending.
Actual Result: The recording and preview UI controls were displayed and the prototype flow worked. Actual microphone recording and audio playback could not be verified because they are simulated in Figma.

Steps: Attempt to send a recording shorter than five seconds.
Expected Result: The user cannot send a recording shorter than five seconds; the interface explains the minimum duration.
Actual Result: The prototype has no timer or duration indicator and does not prevent a recording under five seconds from being sent; the minimum-duration rule is not implemented.

Steps: Select Re-record and make a new recording.
Expected Result: The previous recording is cleared and the user can create a replacement recording.
Actual Result: The Re-record control returned to the recording interface and the replacement-recording UI flow worked. Actual audio replacement could not be verified because recording is simulated in Figma.

Steps: Send a valid reply to the selected friend.
Expected Result: A sent confirmation appears and the conversation screen opens.
Actual Result: The reply was sent successfully, the confirmation appeared and the conversation screen opened.

Steps: Play a friend's voice message, switch to 0.75×, then return to 1×.
Expected Result: The message plays and both 1× and 0.75× playback speeds can be selected.
Actual Result: Play and playback-speed controls worked at the available speeds.

User Story / Requirement: US2 — P1 enhancement; out of MVP scope
Steps: Look for and select one of the preset reactions on a friend's message.
Expected Result: Preset reactions are available to select and are attached to the message.
Actual Result: No preset reaction option was available in the prototype.

Steps: Open the conversation menu. Select Report, Block, Mute and Turn Off one at a time; inspect the resulting screen or confirmation for each action.
Expected Result: The conversation menu shows Report, Block, Mute and Turn Off; each option opens its corresponding reason, confirmation or settings screen.
Actual Result: The Report, Block, Mute and Turn Off options were visible in the conversation menu, and each opened its corresponding prototype screen or confirmation.

Steps: Open Choose a Friend with an account that has no eligible mutual friends.
Expected Result: A clear empty state explains that no eligible mutual friends are available and tells the user what they can do next.
Actual Result: No empty-state screen or empty-state message for users without eligible mutual friends was present in the prototype.

User Story / Requirement: US1 — recording and microphone permission handling
Steps: On the recording screen, try to cancel a recording. Separately, deny microphone permission when prompted and observe the response.
Expected Result: The user can cancel without sending audio. If microphone permission is denied, the app explains the issue and provides a clear next step to enable permission or leave the flow.
Actual Result: The prototype does not show a recording-cancel control or a microphone-permission-denied state.

Steps: Attempt to record beyond the 60-second limit or inspect the recording interface for enforcement of the maximum duration.
Expected Result: Recording stops at 60 seconds or the interface prevents recording or sending audio longer than 60 seconds.
Actual Result: The prototype has no visible timer or duration indicator and does not demonstrate enforcement of a 60-second maximum.

Steps: Complete a two-way exchange in the same thread, with both participants sending a voice message. Check the conversation header or status.
Expected Result: After both participants have sent a message, the conversation displays a “spoke today” indicator. It does not imply that the daily lesson is complete.
Actual Result: Not run: the existing UAT pass did not verify the completed-exchange state or the “spoke today” indicator.
